days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Happy to deliver the Fiesta de San Cayetano for 143 with 10 delivery days. A fair deal we can sign today.
Rápido y justo: 128 P, día 3. ¿Qué día de entrega te va mejor? / Quick and fair: 128 P, day 3. Which delivery day suits you best?
Happy to meet you partway: 137 P with delivery on day 5.
